product_metadata.title: Flyby Portable Reusable Drinking Straws | Collapsible & Foldable Telescopic Stainless Steel Metal Straw Dispenser | Final Aluminum Case, Long Cleaning Brush, Silicone Tip | Gold | 1-Pack
features: Earth Friendly - Our mission is to create less waste in the world, so we've invested in a durable product that'll last a lifetime so you can reduce waste and save the earth.

Portable Design - The Stainless Steel Metal Straw dispenser is telescopic, which is perfectly compatible with 12-40 oz cups. The straw can be packed into in the small keychain container. You can attach the case to your belt or bag and sip on the go.
Food-Grade & Safe - Made from a premium food-grade 304 stainless steel. It's temperature regulated and perfect for enjoying any cold or hot drink.

Easy to Clean - The extra long telescopic scrub brush allows you to clean the inside of the straw dispenser easily. Unlike silicone straws, ours does not leave a residual "coffee flavor" after cleaning.
We're so confident you'll love our product that if you’re not completely satisfied, we will provide a replacement or a full refund (with no product to return).
